conflicts.issue: AAOIFI SS (8) is the named Murabahah standard, but official clauses were not retrieved. SBP IBD Circular 01 of 2012 supplies only invoice/payment operational instructions for Pakistani IBIs. These are not the same rule-set.
conflicts.difference: Cannot compare clause-level Murabahah conditions. SBP text is operational documentation/payment; AAOIFI body text is unavailable here.
conflicts.decision_rationale: Evaluate only verified SBP operational rules. AAOIFI clause evaluation is gated as INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION. Layer A remains PARTIAL. Overall status cannot be PASS for Murabahah identifications.

conflicts.issue: SECP SGR 2023 excludes SBP-regulated banking companies; SBP SGF applies to IBIs.
conflicts.difference: Different regulators and different legal objects (companies/securities vs IBI products).
conflicts.product_scope: Not a textual contradiction; complementary exclusive scopes.
conflicts.decision_rationale: Apply SGF rules only when institution_class=IBI. Apply SGR security-claim rules only when a security claim is made and the institution is not an IBI.

conflicts.issue: IBD Circular 01 of 2012 amends invoice instructions that originated in IBD Circular 02 of 2008 Appendix-A Murabaha sub clause vi. The 2008 annex PDF was not retrieved.
conflicts.difference: 2012 is the later retrieved operative circular for invoice/payment. Unretrieved 2008 clauses are not implemented.
conflicts.decision_rationale: Implement only 2012 paragraphs 1, 2, and 4. Do not reconstruct 2008 Essentials from memory.
